d: Centuries of myth, plundered burials, and vanished civilizations lie sealed beneath crumbling stone and inaccessible landscapes. Across this captivating compilation of high-stakes excavations, explorer Josh Gates sets out on a global mission exploring ruins for sacred tombs & relics hidden deep within remote terrain. Using advanced subsurface mapping technology to solve enduring historical mysteries, teams navigate volatile subterranean environments where Josh Gates explores secret ruins and tombs that have remained untouched by human hands for thousands of years. Ground-penetrating radar…
